## Fundamentals #0047: Monolithic Power Systems: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-10-30 00:23
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-29-0047/


Monolithic Power Systems (MPWR) revenue in the third quarter was 1.20 billion USD (+63.1% y/y), and earnings per share (adjusted) reached 8.19 USD (+73.2% y/y).

### Quarterly results

Gross margin was 55.4% (0.3 pp y/y), while operating income was 357.69 million USD (+83.3% y/y). Earnings per share (GAAP) was 5.51 USD (+47.3% y/y), and earnings per share (GAAP, basic) reached 5.53 USD (+47.5% y/y).

### What management says

Management assesses growth drivers very well, although they indicate it is still too early for next year's forecast. According to management, notebook sales are weaker due to memory shortages at manufacturers, but in the long term, this market is viewed optimistically thanks to technology and market share. Management emphasized that at the current growth rate, operating costs will come in below the company's model due to R&D efficiency. According to management, increasing production capacity should not require a large increase in capital expenditures or a change in capital structure. Management also noted that the company is not raising prices, but rather sharing part of the cost increase with customers.

## Fundamentals #0046: Mondelez International: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-10-30 00:20
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-29-0046/


Mondelez International (MDLZ) revenue in the third quarter was 9.97 billion USD (+2.3% y/y), and net income increased by 75.3% y/y to a level of 1.31 billion USD.

### Quarterly results

Operating income reached 1.76 billion USD (+136.3% y/y), while earnings per share (reported) and earnings per share (reported, basic) were 1.02 USD (+79.0% y/y). Adjusted earnings per share was at a level of 0.78 USD.

### Company guidance

The company expects free cash flows at a level of 3.00 billion USD.

### What management says

Management emphasized that consumer confidence in emerging markets remains resilient, and chocolate sales in Brazil are starting to rebound in terms of volume. According to management, the new promotion tactics in North America are yielding good results, and despite the weaker situation in China, the company views this market positively. Management indicated that surpluses will be reinvested in emerging markets and product innovations, and costs related to the war in the Middle East are included in the current guidance. According to management, cocoa inventories are at an appropriate level, allowing for the coverage of potential shortages, and regarding development, the company is not looking for large acquisitions, but rather targeted smaller purchases to fill regional and product gaps.

## Fundamentals #0045: Gilead Sciences: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-10-30 00:17
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-29-0045/


Gilead Sciences (GILD) revenue in the third quarter was 8.30 billion USD (+6.8% y/y), while earnings per share (GAAP) fell by 20.2% y/y to 1.94 USD.

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (GAAP, basic) was 1.96 USD (−20.3% y/y), while adjusted earnings per share increased by 3.2% y/y to 2.55 USD. Operating income reached 3.46 billion USD (+4.1% y/y), with an operating margin at 41.7% (−1.1 pp y/y).

### Management commentary

According to management, the HIV segment benefited from favorable pricing in certain channels and demand, and Biktarvy's market share continues to grow. Management emphasized that the company is focused on growth in the areas of oncology and inflammatory diseases. According to management, weekly oral HIV prevention is intended to reach individuals who prefer long-acting medications instead of injections. Management indicated that the way drug pricing is established under the IRA act may threaten investments in new products next year. According to management, the impact of new prices primarily concerns the Medicare program and manifests as a spillover effect to other sales channels. Management expressed satisfaction that the company absorbed the costs of newly acquired programs this year and intends to continue this process in the following years.

## Fundamentals #0044: Intel: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-10-29 23:55
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-29-0044/


Intel (INTC) revenue in the third quarter was 16.51 billion USD (+20.9% y/y), while earnings per share (GAAP) fell to 0.60 USD (−33.3% y/y).

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (GAAP, basic) reached 0.63 USD (−30.0% y/y), while earnings per share (adjusted) increased by 126.1% y/y to 0.52 USD. The company's operating income was 2.52 billion USD, representing a 269.2% y/y increase compared to 683.00 million USD a year earlier.

### Company guidance

In the fourth quarter of 2026, the company expects revenue in the range of 15.00 billion USD – 16.00 billion USD.

### What management says

Management expressed optimism regarding growth in the data center segment. According to management, the company may not generate positive free cash flows next year, as it views this period as an opportunity to invest in growth. Management indicated that capacity released by the weaker PC market can be allocated to data center wafers, however, substrate availability is also a constraint. According to management, the situation regarding memory availability next year is not optimistic. Management emphasized that external fab customers are expressing interest and are satisfied with the production yields, which the company is working intensively on. According to management, Panther Lake processor margins have clearly improved, although they have not yet reached the company-wide average.

## Fundamentals #0043: Starbucks: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-10-29 22:33
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-29-0043/


Starbucks (SBUX) revenue fell by 4.5% y/y in the third quarter of fiscal year 2026 to 9.14 billion USD, while net income increased by 408.8% y/y to 677.20 million USD.

### Quarterly results

Operating income was 991.80 million USD (+256.5% y/y), and earnings per share (GAAP) stood at 0.59 USD, with adjusted earnings per share of 0.80 USD. In the Company-operated coffeehouses segment, revenue fell by 5.5% y/y to 7.43 billion USD, whereas the Licensed coffeehouses segment saw an increase of 9.4% y/y to 1.20 billion USD, while the Other segment shrank by 16.0% y/y to 515.50 million USD.

## Fundamentals #0042: Xcel Energy: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-10-29 17:26
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-29-0042/


Xcel Energy (XEL) revenues increased in Q3 by 6.6% y/y to 4.17 billion USD, and earnings per share (reported) increased by 72.7% y/y to 1.52 USD.

### Quarterly results

no data.

### Company guidance

The company expects earnings per share in the range of 4.10 USD – 4.16 USD, 4.48 USD – 4.62 USD and 4.04 USD – 4.16 USD.

### Management commentary

Management emphasized that it is conducting advanced negotiations for an energy supply agreement with a large consumer, pointing to the greatest opportunities in the Midwest, Texas, and New Mexico regions. According to management, all investments serve customers through a focus on safety, reliability, and meeting the growing demand for electricity. Management noted that it wants to maintain a strong balance sheet, with plans to expect greater financial flexibility in the later years of the plan. According to management, data centers should self-fund the facilities being built for them, and the company will not connect facilities that do not benefit other customers. Management also indicated that oil companies are increasingly transitioning to electric power, which is driving electricity sales in the Texas and New Mexico region. According to management, combined-cycle gas power plants may become profitable in the future.

## Fundamentals #0041: DoorDash: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-10-29 15:39
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-29-0041/


DoorDash (DASH) revenue in the third quarter was 4.62 billion USD (34.0% y/y), and net income increased by 91.0% y/y to the level of 466.00 million USD.

### Quarterly results

Gross margin reached 50.1% (1.1 pp y/y), while earnings per share (GAAP) was 1.06 USD (92.7% y/y), with earnings per share (non-GAAP, adjusted) at the level of 1.07 USD (87.7% y/y).

### Company guidance

The company expects free cash flows in the range of 700.00 million USD – 800.00 million USD.

### Management commentary

Management emphasized that the core business is performing very well, and growth is driven by increasing users and subscriptions. According to management, combining both platforms is intended to accelerate growth and increase profit, with part of the profit to be reinvested into a better product. Management also indicated that building a common technology platform is intended to facilitate and accelerate future integrations of acquired companies. According to management, the approach to share buybacks remains unchanged and the company intends to buy them occasionally when it yields a good return.

## Fundamentals #0039: Cadence Design Systems: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-10-29 08:17
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-29-0039/


Cadence Design Systems (CDNS) revenue in the third quarter was 1.63 billion USD (+22.0% y/y), while earnings per share (adjusted) increased by 9.3% y/y to 2.11 USD.

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (GAAP) was 1.05 USD (0.0% y/y), and earnings per share (GAAP, diluted) was 1.06 USD (0.0% y/y).

### Company guidance

The company expects fourth quarter revenue in the range of 1.70 billion USD – 1.73 billion USD, and forecasts full-year revenue at 6.39 billion USD – 6.42 billion USD.

### Management commentary

Management emphasized that recurring revenue is performing very well, and AI agents are increasing the use of the company's core tools. According to management, AI agents are driving demand for chip design tools because they can call the company's compute engines multiple times. Management indicated that the company's strategy focuses on selling high-value engineering software, rather than building large-scale general-purpose AI infrastructure. According to management, design verification hardware recorded another record quarter due to demand from customers in the AI industry, and the company expects another record year in the hardware segment in subsequent quarters, although sales may fluctuate between quarters.

## Fundamentals #0038: T-Mobile US: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-10-29 02:20
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-29-0038/


T-Mobile US (TMUS) revenues in the third quarter increased by 7.4% y/y to 23.58 billion USD, and earnings per share (GAAP) increased by 33.6% y/y to 3.22 USD.

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (GAAP, diluted) was 3.23 USD (33.5% y/y), while operating income reached 5.66 billion USD (25.0% y/y).

### Company guidance

The company expects revenues in the range of 37.35 billion USD – 37.45 billion USD and free cash flows in the range of 18.70 billion USD – 18.80 billion USD, with a tax rate of 24.0% – 25.0%.

### Management commentary

Management emphasized that in fixed broadband via cellular networks, they see continued strong growth and increasing revenue per customer. According to management, gains from AI-driven radio network planning exceeded expectations. Management noted that satellite connectivity is treated as a complementary product, therefore they do not foresee reselling another operator's satellite services on their network. According to management, the company aims to maintain a balance between the number of customers and their value, focusing on acquiring accounts and translating this into a financial advantage. Management also pointed to a belief in bundling services rather than strictly combining fixed and mobile telephony.

## Fundamentals #0037: KLA: 1Q2027 results

Date: 2026-10-29 02:17
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-29-0037/


KLA (KLAC) revenues in the first quarter of fiscal year 2027 were 4.14 billion USD (+28.9% y/y), and net income increased by 38.1% y/y to 1.55 billion USD.

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (adjusted) reached 1.22 USD (+38.6% y/y), while earnings per share (reported) was 1.18 USD (+38.8% y/y). In the Semiconductor Process Control segment, revenues were 3.75 billion USD (+29.5% y/y), while the Specialty Semiconductor Process segment recorded 139.49 million USD (+16.5% y/y).

### Management commentary

According to management, further growth is expected to be more even, while simultaneously expecting quarter-over-quarter growth. Management emphasized that DRAM memory manufacturers appreciated the value of higher production yields, which translates into increasing process control intensity. According to management, sales in China are growing significantly slower than on a company-wide scale. Management also indicated that due to customer pressure to prioritize projects, the company must invest in human resources, facilities, and the supply chain.

## Fundamentals #0036: Honeywell Aerospace: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-10-29 01:52
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-29-0036/


Honeywell Aerospace (HONA) revenues increased in the third quarter by 2.5% y/y to 4.64 billion USD, and earnings per share (reported) increased by 12.8% y/y to 2.29 USD.

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (reported, basic) was 2.29 USD (+12.8% y/y).

### Company guidance

For the full year 2026, the company expects organic growth at a level of 4.0% – 5.0%, adjusted earnings per share in the range of 7.85–8.00 USD, pro forma standalone adjusted EBIT of 4.38 billion USD – 4.42 billion USD, and free cash flows at a level of 1.20 billion USD – 1.40 billion USD.

### What management says

Management emphasized that the gap between the company's needs and deliveries from suppliers is narrowing. According to management, with increasing deliveries, the priority is serving aircraft manufacturers to maintain the continuity of their production lines, before fulfilling orders for the aftermarket. Management indicated that the company is directing a larger number of deliveries toward US national security needs than to foreign customers, while the order backlog shows no declines. According to management, electronic component shortages have not significantly impacted operations, and no changes in customer behavior resulting from oil prices were observed in passenger aviation. Management also stated that negotiations for renewed contracts with manufacturers are proceeding as expected and will allow for a better alignment of prices with costs.

## Fundamentals #0035: Fortinet: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-10-29 01:49
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-29-0035/


Fortinet (FTNT) revenue in the third quarter of fiscal year 2026 was 2.08 billion USD (+20.5% y/y), and earnings per share (GAAP) increased to 0.86 USD (+38.7% y/y).

### Quarterly results

Operating income reached 704.30 million USD (+28.7% y/y), with net income amounting to 635.50 million USD (+34.1% y/y). Broken down by segments, Product segment revenue was 765.00 million USD (+36.8% y/y), while the Service segment generated 1.31 billion USD (+12.7% y/y). Earnings per share (GAAP, basic) was 0.87 USD (+38.1% y/y), while earnings per share (adjusted) fell to 0.05 USD (−58.3% y/y).

### What management says

Management emphasized that network security is a key element of AI protection, enabling better insight into traffic generated by these technologies. According to management, demand remains solid, and increasing threats are motivating customers to modernize security. Management indicated that the company does not see a slowdown in demand, although it notes lengthening delivery times. According to management, in the second half of the year, rising costs affected product margins, while service margins grew significantly. Management noted that customers deploying infrastructure do not always want to pay for services immediately, which represents only a shift in the timing of revenue recognition. According to management, more and more companies are launching their own open AI models, which increases the demand for their monitoring and securing.

## Fundamentals #0034: Alphabet: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-10-29 01:42
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-29-0034/


Alphabet (GOOGL) revenue increased in Q3 2026 by 24.6% y/y to 127.58 billion USD, while earnings per share (accounting) fell by 26.1% y/y to 2.12 USD.

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (accounting, basic) was 2.14 USD (−25.9% y/y).

### What management says

According to management, using Gemini generates revenue from the model itself and drives growth in other parts of the cloud offering. Management emphasized that AI agents will become a reality, and the company wants to provide users with next-generation agents. According to management, AI agents represent an opportunity for the search engine to expand the range of problems solved for users. Management noted that the allocation of computing power is a long-term process requiring advance planning. The company treats TPU systems as an important platform that is intended to compete in the market for customers with the most demanding tasks. Management also explained that the TPU system is not just the chip itself, but an entire system including hardware, computing power, storage, and networking.

## Fundamentals #0033: Microsoft: 1Q2027 results

Date: 2026-10-29 01:36
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-29-0033/


Microsoft (MSFT) revenue in the first quarter of fiscal year 2027 increased by 18.8% y/y to 92.28 billion USD, and net income increased by 32.0% y/y to 36.63 billion USD.

### Quarterly results

Operating income was 45.91 billion USD, representing a 20.9% y/y increase compared to 37.96 billion USD the previous year. Earnings per share (GAAP) reached 4.92 USD (+32.3% y/y), while earnings per share (GAAP, diluted) was 4.93 USD (+32.2% y/y).

### What management says

Management emphasized that it strives for maximum efficiency and interchangeability of the entire infrastructure, with capacity being allocated according to demand signals. According to management, engineering teams are regularly improving efficiency at the platform level. Management indicated that the key way to maintain margin is revenue growth. According to management, with every new AI model, the Copilot subscription is intended to deliver increasing value to customers. Management noted that although the transition to consumption-based billing outside of programming will take more time, encouraging signals are visible. Management also emphasized that the company has great flexibility in securing financing on attractive terms.

## Fundamentals #0032: Teradyne: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-10-28 21:49
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-28-0032/


Teradyne (TER) revenue in Q3 was 1.31 billion USD (+69.8% y/y), and earnings per share (GAAP) increased to 2.17 USD (+189.3% y/y).

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (GAAP, basic) stood at 2.19 USD (+192.0% y/y), while earnings per share (adjusted) was 2.29 USD (+169.4% y/y).

### Company guidance

In Q4 2026, the company expects revenue in the range of 1.25 billion USD – 1.35 billion USD, with adjusted earnings per share at 1.95–2.25 USD.

### Management commentary

Management expects significant growth in the memory segment in the coming year, which is expected to encompass all segments, with a particular focus on HBM technology. According to management, inventories are increasing due to preparations for growth and extended lead times for component deliveries for testers; therefore, the company is aggressively increasing production capacity in the area of memory testers and power test lines. Management emphasized that growth is expected to accelerate quarter by quarter in the coming year, although the company avoids specific forecasts due to the volatility of customer test line assembly cycles. According to management, the robotics portfolio is expanding, and solid growth is expected from the largest customer in the coming year. Management remains interested in co-packaged optics technology, but its development pace depends on profitability allowing for increased production.

## Fundamentals #0031: GE HealthCare Technologies: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-10-28 21:42
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-28-0031/


GE HealthCare Technologies (GEHC) revenue increased in Q3 by 7.2% y/y to 5.51 billion USD, and earnings per share (reported) increased by 38.8% y/y to 1.36 USD.

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (reported, basic) was 1.36 USD (+38.8% y/y), while earnings per share (adjusted) reached 1.34 USD (+25.2% y/y).

### Company guidance

The company expects for the full year 2026 organic revenue growth at 4.0%, EBIT margin in the range of 15.5% – 15.7%, tax rate of 20.0% – 21.0%, earnings per share (adjusted) in the range of 4.95–5.05 USD (an increase of 7.9% – 10.1%), and free cash flow of at least 1.60 billion USD.

### Management commentary

Management emphasized that imaging technologies are at the top of customers' investment expenditure lists, and sales of the new PET imaging product are progressing as expected. According to management, the sales opportunity pipeline remains strong and growing, which forms the basis of market resilience. Management also indicated that the development of data centers and AI affects the availability of certain components, however, the company has secured priority in deliveries and pricing. According to management, year-end guidance reflects current strength, while maintaining caution regarding the changing macroeconomic environment.

## Fundamentals #0030: Automatic Data Processing: 1Q2027 results

Date: 2026-10-28 21:39
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-28-0030/


Automatic Data Processing (ADP) revenues increased in the first quarter of fiscal year 2027 by 6.1% y/y to 5.49 billion USD, and earnings per share (reported) increased by 13.7% y/y to 2.83 USD.

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (reported, basic) was 2.84 USD (13.6% y/y).

### Company guidance

For the full fiscal year 2027, the company expects revenue growth of 6.0%, (adjusted) earnings per share growth in the range of 10.0% – 12.0%, and earnings per share growth of 12.0% – 14.0%. The company also forecasts interest income at 1.59 billion USD – 1.61 billion USD and a tax rate of 23.0%.

### What management says

Management emphasized that progress in the field of artificial intelligence, especially regarding the ADP Assist assistant, is significant. According to management, the selection of subsequent AI agents is based on solutions that provide measurable results to clients and solve real problems. Management indicated that the new agreement regarding the inclusion of payroll into the banking platform is a key element of strategic priority, and similar discussions are ongoing. According to management, client employment results in the quarter were satisfactory and represent a continuation of growing momentum. Management believes it is in the interest of shareholders to allocate part of the improvement in results to dividends and part to further development.

## Log #0214: Session summary 2026-10-28: NDX 29821.65 (+0.55%)

Date: 2026-10-28 21:03
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/posts/log-0214/


**Session date:** 2026-10-28

> *Session close 2026-10-28: NDX 29821.65 (+0.55%), NQ 30066.75 (+0.85%), QQQ 725.48 (+0.59%).*

---

### Session overview

## Fundamentals #0029: Old Dominion Freight Line: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-10-28 19:49
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-28-0029/


Old Dominion Freight Line (ODFL) revenue in Q3 was 1.59 billion USD (+13.1% y/y), and earnings per share (reported) increased by 28.9% y/y to 1.65 USD.

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (reported, basic) reached 1.66 USD (+28.7% y/y) compared to 1.29 USD in the previous year.

### Company guidance

Capital expenditures in FY 2026 are expected to be 380.00 million USD.

### Management commentary

According to management, demand remains stable, and discussions with customers indicate an improving demand environment. Management emphasized that higher shipment weight allows maintaining stable revenue per unit of weight without fuel, confirming the effectiveness of the pricing policy. Management also indicated that most of the increase in cost per employee results from rising supplemental benefit costs related to inflation in healthcare. According to management, the company has a large reserve of capacity in real estate and equipment, and due to in-house driver training, it does not experience issues with employee recruitment. Management noted that by maintaining the current revenue level and seasonally better-than-usual results, the operating ratio should be at the lower limit of the normal range of deterioration.


---

## Fundamentals #0028: PayPal: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-10-28 19:42
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-28-0028/


PayPal (PYPL) revenue in Q3 was 8.58 billion USD (+2.0% y/y), while earnings per share (accounting) fell to 1.25 USD (−3.9% y/y).

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (accounting, basic) was 1.26 USD (−3.8% y/y). The company's operating income was at the level of 1.40 billion USD (−7.8% y/y).

### What management says

Management emphasized that the goal is to increase Venmo's significance in customers' daily finances by developing the current base and expanding the offering with financial services. According to management, financial services constitute a key driver of future transaction margin growth, in which the company intends to continue investing. Management also indicated that AI agent-led commerce is a priority and a great opportunity for the company, based on trust and security. Management also noted that in the area of credit financing, it will maintain a balanced approach between on-balance sheet and off-balance sheet. According to management, the impact of EU de minimis customs duties on trade in Europe will also persist in the next quarter. Management also emphasized that it is open to an objective analysis of options to increase shareholder value, and is currently focusing on the implementation of its own plan.


---

## Fundamentals #0027: Baker Hughes: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-10-28 19:39
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-28-0027/


Baker Hughes (BKR) revenue increased by 14.5% y/y in the third quarter to 8.03 billion USD, while net income fell by 32.5% y/y to 411.00 million USD.

### Quarterly results

Adjusted earnings per share were 0.70 USD (2.9% y/y), while reported earnings per share fell to 0.41 USD (−32.8% y/y).

### What management says

Management emphasized that order growth is driven by enduring trends, such as increasing demand for power generation capacity in the United States related to data centers and investments in gas infrastructure. According to management, order strength is broad, manifesting in growth in power systems and LNG, as well as a growing equipment base supporting service. Management expects revenue growth and EBITDA margin expansion in the following year, noting that margin improvement will not be linear but will result from cost synergies and a more favorable sales mix. According to management, a seasonal decline will occur in the first quarter in subsequent quarters, with a clearer improvement in the second half of the year. At the same time, management is taking a cautious approach to short-term prospects in the Middle East, expecting a weakening of activity in this region.


---

## Fundamentals #0026: NXP Semiconductors: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-10-28 19:36
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-28-0026/


NXP Semiconductors (NXPI) revenues in Q3 were 3.79 billion USD (+19.3% y/y), and earnings per share (GAAP) increased to 3.48 USD (+40.3% y/y).

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (GAAP, basic) reached 3.51 USD (+40.4% y/y), while earnings per share (adjusted) was 4.20 USD (+35.0% y/y).

### What management says

Management emphasized that no widespread inventory replenishment is being observed in the automotive sector, with longer lead times improving demand visibility. According to management, confidence in continued growth is based on the increasing adoption of software-defined vehicles and the impact of artificial intelligence on industry and the Internet of Things. Management indicated that the gross margin improvement is structural and results from higher revenues, better fab utilization, and operational efficiency, while price increases merely cover higher costs. According to management, there is a structural shift in pricing within the industry, allowing semiconductors to capture a larger share of value in systems. Management noted that in data centers, growth depends on product launches, their adoption, and software deployment by customers. According to management, the company already has won projects in North America and the Asia-Pacific region, and is also conducting several pilots in China and Europe.


---

## Fundamentals #0025: Seagate Technology Holdings PLC: 1Q2027 results

Date: 2026-10-28 19:33
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-28-0025/


Seagate Technology Holdings PLC (STX) revenues in the first quarter were 4.23 billion USD (+61.0% y/y), and earnings per share (reported) increased to 7.59 USD (+212.3% y/y).

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (reported, basic) reached 7.72 USD (+199.2% y/y), while earnings per share (adjusted) was 7.68 USD. The company's operating income was 2.06 billion USD (+197.4% y/y).

### Management commentary

Management emphasized that instead of destroying demand, they are observing its increasing creation on a quarter-to-quarter basis. According to management, the slower growth in shipments in the past period was planned well in advance and was not a result of issues during product transitions. Management noted that the pricing strategy remains unchanged, and new contracts incorporate higher costs of external components, which are more than covered by rising prices. According to management, the share buyback will clearly increase from the next quarter, as the company no longer plans further debt repayment activities. Management also indicated that corporate customers and hardware manufacturers are increasingly less likely to fall behind in purchasing the highest-capacity drives.

## Log #0212: Session summary 2026-10-26: NDX 29272.46 (+1.09%)

Date: 2026-10-26 21:03
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/posts/log-0212/


> ⚠️ **ERRATUM (2026-10-27)**
> **The first version of this entry gave the closing state of the market from an outdated reading.** In the last minutes of the session, old readings from earlier in the day and from Friday reached Heniu alongside the current ones: with the current percentage change, but with an old price, flow, daily range and market breadth. The close was recorded from such a reading. We have corrected the numbers throughout the entry using the current readings.
>
> **Corrections:**
> - Close: NDX 29272.46, NQ 29443.50 and QQQ 712.12, not 28961.08, 29100.25 and 704.45. The percentage changes were correct.
> - Session minimum: NDX 29017.13 at 10:02 ET (15:02 PL), not 28957.53 at 15:55 ET. The close is 130.09 pts below the maximum and 255.33 pts above the minimum (session range 385.42 pts).
> - Last hour of the session: NDX fell by 32.37 pts (-0.11%), not by 343.75 pts (-1.17%).
> - Cumulative flow (CVD) at the close: NDX −114.75 M [panic], NQ 21.79 K [accumulation], QQQ 2.85 M [market flare]. The direction was divergent, but it was the NDX flow that was negative, not the NQ flow.
> - Market breadth (TICKQ) at the close: -226.00 [market breakdown] with the SMA200 average at -26.25 [sell-off], not 437.00 and -17.45.
> - Average daily range (ADR) utilization: NDX 99.15%, NQ 99.20%, QQQ 99.38%, not 34.29%, 45.96% and 34.40%.
> - Drawdown from the highest close: -6.26%, not -7.26%.
> - The opening, the maximum, the MOC anomaly, the QQQ options and the basket data were correct. The session data health line measures the continuity of readings and does not detect such old readings.

> *Session close 2026-10-26: NDX 29272.46 (+1.09%), NQ 29443.50 (+1.12%), QQQ 712.12 (+1.11%).*
